revision.text:
{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries}} {{Cite source|date=December 2018}} {{color}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|ja|魔方陣}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}} ({{ill|wood|ja|木}}, {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|earth|ja|土}}, {{ill|metal|ja|金}}, and {{ill|water|ja|水}}), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|ja|十干}}, the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|ja|十二支}}, and the {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}} of {{ill|I Ching|ja|易経}}. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|ja|禹}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|ja|洛書}}), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|ja|河図洛書}}.
== The Nine Stars == In Japanese {{ill|Onmyōdō|ja|陰陽道}}, the following table associates the Nine Stars with the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}}, {{ill|directions|ja|方位}}, {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}}, and colors, forming the '''Nine Stars Chart''' used to predict {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}} and the {{ill|auspiciousness|ja|吉凶}} of directions based on a person's birth year.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}} - Metal * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Qian (乾) * {{ill|Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Geng (庚), Xin (辛) * {{ill|Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Xu (戌), Hai (亥) * Season - Late Autumn * Direction - {{ill|Northwest|ja|西北}} * Month - October, November * Time - 19:00–23:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, {{ill|lungs|ja|肺}}, {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition * Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving * Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|ja|九紫火星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Roppaku Kinsei, {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}}
== Years in Which Roppaku Kinsei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 5 are Roppaku Kinsei years.
‥‥ - [[1940]] - [[1949]] - [[1958]] - [[1967]] - [[1976]] - [[1985]] - [[1994]] - [[2003]] - [[2012]] - [[2021]] - [[2030]] - [[2039]] - [[2048]] - [[2057]] - [[2066]] - ‥‥

'''六白金星'''（ろっぱくきんせい）とは、[[暦]]、[[占い]]に用いられる[[九星]]の一つ。後天定位盤において西北に位置する。
七赤金星と同じ金に属するが、六白金星は、金としては鉱山から掘り出したままの原石を表すという。
==属性== *[[五行思想|五行]] - 金 *[[八卦]] - 乾 *[[十干]] - 庚、辛 *[[十二支]] - 戌、亥 *季節 - 晩秋 *方位 - [[西北]] *月 - 10月、11月 *時間 - 19時～23時 *数 - 四、九 *色 - 白色 *味 - 辛味
==象意== *動く、多忙、決断、都、人の集まる場所、目上、気品、天皇、[[肺]]、[[免疫]]、父、防衛、天、完全、威厳、権力、勝負、 *円、争い、規則、信仰、堅固、懐妊、高慢、充実、太陽、高級品、車、多忙、供養、施す、戦う、すこやか、寄付、世話事、肋骨、肋膜、血圧作用、汗、発熱、腫れ物、心臓、左肺、骨折、めまい、扁桃腺、皮膚病
==他の星との関係（相性）== *相生 - [[一白水星]]（金生水）、[[二黒土星]]（土生金）、[[五黄土星]]（土生金）、[[八白土星]]（土生金） *相克 - [[三碧木星]]（金剋木）、[[四緑木星]]（金剋木）、[[九紫火星]]（火剋金） *比和 - 六白金星、[[七赤金星]]
==六白金星の（中宮になる）年== 西暦年を9で割って5余る年が六白金星の年となる。
‥‥ - [[1940年]] - [[1949年]] - [[1958年]] - [[1967年]] - [[1976年]] - [[1985年]] - [[1994年]] - [[2003年]] - [[2012年]] - [[2021年]] - [[2030年]] - [[2039年]] - [[2048年]] - [[2057年]] - [[2066年]] - ‥‥

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Metal (wuxing)|es|Metal (Wu Xing)|lt=Metal (金)|4=it|5=Metallo (elemento)|6=vi|7=Kim (Ngũ hành)|8=tr|9=Metal (klasik element)|10=uk|11=Метал (У-сін)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Metal (wuxing)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Qián (Bagua)|ja|乾|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian (乾)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|zh|庚|gan|庚|hak|Kâng (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoe (庚)|vi|Canh (Thiên can)|za|Geng (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Keⁿ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|庚 (天干)|zh|庚|qq=}}, {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|zh|辛|gan|辛|hak|Sîn (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|vi|Tân (Thiên can)|za|Sin (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Sin (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|辛 (天干)|zh|辛 (天干)|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]], [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] * Season - Late Autumn * Direction - {{ill|Northwest|ja|西北|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 北西|1=northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q5491373}} * Month - October, November * Time - 19:00–23:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, [[:en:Lung|lungs]], {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition * Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving * Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Roppaku Kinsei, {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Metal (wuxing)|es|Metal (Wu Xing)|lt=Metal (金)|4=it|5=Metallo (elemento)|6=vi|7=Kim (Ngũ hành)|8=tr|9=Metal (klasik element)|10=uk|11=Метал (У-сін)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Metal (wuxing)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Qián (Bagua)|ja|乾|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian (乾)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|zh|庚|gan|庚|hak|Kâng (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoe (庚)|vi|Canh (Thiên can)|za|Geng (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Keⁿ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|庚 (天干)|zh|庚|qq=}}, {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|zh|辛|gan|辛|hak|Sîn (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|vi|Tân (Thiên can)|za|Sin (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Sin (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|辛 (天干)|zh|辛 (天干)|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]], [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] * Season - Late Autumn * Direction - {{ill|Northwest|ja|西北|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 北西|1=northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q5491373}} * Month - October, November * Time - 19:00–23:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, [[:en:Lung|lungs]], {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition * Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving * Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Roppaku Kinsei, {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Roppaku is in the center |- | 5 || 1 || 3 |- | 4 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold" | 6 || 8 |- | 9 || 2 || 7 |}
'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Metal (wuxing)|es|Metal (Wu Xing)|lt=Metal (金)|4=it|5=Metallo (elemento)|6=vi|7=Kim (Ngũ hành)|8=tr|9=Metal (klasik element)|10=uk|11=Метал (У-сін)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Metal (wuxing)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Qián (Bagua)|ja|乾|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian (乾)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|zh|庚|gan|庚|hak|Kâng (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoe (庚)|vi|Canh (Thiên can)|za|Geng (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Keⁿ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|庚 (天干)|zh|庚|qq=}}, {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|zh|辛|gan|辛|hak|Sîn (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|vi|Tân (Thiên can)|za|Sin (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Sin (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|辛 (天干)|zh|辛 (天干)|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]], [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] * Season - Late Autumn * Direction - {{ill|Northwest|ja|西北|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 北西|1=northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q5491373}} * Month - October, November * Time - 19:00–23:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, [[:en:Lung|lungs]], {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition * Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving * Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Roppaku Kinsei, {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Metal (wuxing)|es|Metal (Wu Xing)|lt=Metal (金)|4=it|5=Metallo (elemento)|6=vi|7=Kim (Ngũ hành)|8=tr|9=Metal (klasik element)|10=uk|11=Метал (У-сін)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Metal (wuxing)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Qián (Bagua)|ja|乾|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian (乾)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|zh|庚|gan|庚|hak|Kâng (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoe (庚)|vi|Canh (Thiên can)|za|Geng (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Keⁿ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|庚 (天干)|zh|庚|qq=}}, {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|zh|辛|gan|辛|hak|Sîn (thiên-kôn)|ja|Kanoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|vi|Tân (Thiên can)|za|Sin (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Sin (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|辛 (天干)|zh|辛 (天干)|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]], [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] * Season - Late Autumn * Direction - {{ill|Northwest|ja|西北|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 北西|1=northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q5491373}} * Month - October, November * Time - 19:00–23:00 * Number - Four, Nine * Color - White * Taste - Spicy
== Symbolic Meanings == * Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, [[:en:Lung|lungs]], {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition * Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving * Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Metal generates Water), {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Earth generates Metal) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Metal overcomes Wood), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Roppaku Kinsei, {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, [[:en:Lung|lungs]], {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition * Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving * Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.
While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

* Color - White
* Taste - Spicy

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, {{ill|Lung|en|Lung|WD=Q7886|lt=lungs}}, {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition
* Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving
* Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

== Symbolic Meanings ==

* Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving
* Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

* Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving
* Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

== Symbolic Meanings ==

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, {{ill|Lung|en|Lung|WD=Q7886|lt=lungs}}, {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition
* Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving
* Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

* Season - Late Autumn
* Direction - {{ill|Northwest|ja|西北|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Northwest|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 北西|1=Northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q5491373}}
* Month - October, November
* Time - 19:00–23:00
* Number - Four, Nine
* Color - White
* Taste - Spicy

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Movement, busyness, decisions, cities, gathering places, authority figures, elegance, emperors, {{ill|Lung|en|Lung|WD=Q7886|lt=lungs|1=Lung}}, {{ill|immune system|ja|免疫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/immune system|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 免疫系|1=Immune system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1059}}, fathers, defense, heaven, completeness, dignity, power, competition
* Circles, conflicts, regulations, faith, solidity, pregnancy, arrogance, fulfillment, the sun, luxury goods, vehicles, busyness, memorial services, charity, battle, health, donations, caregiving
* Related to the body: ribs, pleura, blood pressure regulation, sweating, fever, tumors, heart, left lung, bone fractures, dizziness, tonsils, skin diseases

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

== Symbolic Meanings ==

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

== Symbolic Meanings ==

'''Roppaku Kinsei''' (六白金星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the northwestern position.

While it belongs to the same Metal element as {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}}, Roppaku Kinsei represents raw ore that has just been extracted from a mine.

== Symbolic Meanings ==
